identity.life_stage: widowed, homebound, dialysis three days a week

engagement.interaction_backstory: Her nephew put the site on her phone and she plays gospel through the dialysis chair three mornings a week, four hours at a time. She knows the catalog better than most people on staff. She has never once managed to find the same album twice without help.

depth.core_contradiction: Prays over the whole prayer list by name every morning and has not asked anybody to pray for her since 2021.
depth.wound: Fifty-two years married and then a Tuesday.
depth.longing: To die at home and not in that chair.
depth.faith_journey: National Baptist, missionary board thirty years, never wavered; the wavering is new and she has not told the pastor.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Calls everybody "sugar"; says "I thank God" before the sentence, not after.
depth.open_doubt: Why He is taking so long about it.

social_graph.note: set up the phone; visits Sundays; the reason she has the thing
knows all her stories and has not gotten tired of them

depth.emotional_weather_default: Serene and warm; angry maybe four times a year and it is something to see.
depth.daily_texture: The chair Monday Wednesday Friday, the phone propped on a folded towel, the porch fan.
depth.sensory_anchor: A church fan with a funeral home on the back, and the heat, and forty women humming.
depth.living_arc: Making peace, slowly, and not telling anybody that is what she is doing.
